marketing.title: From template to AI-driven growth
marketing.lede: Start fast with curated templates, let AI handle personalization, and continuously optimize SEO, GEO, and content.
marketing.visualLabel: CloudCrane workspace with conversation and live preview
marketing.visualPrompt: Update the navigation colors on the homepage.
marketing.workflowTitle: Three steps to lasting website value
marketing.workflowDescription: No complex process required. Three steps are all it takes to build and continuously improve a high-quality website.
marketing.stepConnectDescription: Create a website and complete authorization. CloudCrane prepares a persistent workspace for it.
marketing.stepDescribeDescription: Tell the Agent what you want to do. It reads the real code and completes the work in the workspace.
marketing.stepVerifyDescription: Check the updated page in a real browser before deciding what to do next.
marketing.capabilityDescription: From protected context to real browser verification and continuous iteration, CloudCrane provides complete long-term maintenance so your website stays in its best shape.
marketing.capabilityWorkspaceDescription: Every website has its own workspace. Code and context survive each session, making maintenance more coherent and stable.
marketing.capabilityBrowserDescription: Every change is checked, tested, and verified in a real browser environment so the result matches expectations.
marketing.capabilityMaintenanceDescription: The Agent can keep contributing to development, changes, verification, and iteration so your website stays at its best.
marketing.pricingDescription: Start free and upgrade as needed. Whether it is a personal project or an enterprise website, CloudCrane has a plan that fits.
marketing.pricingFreeDescription: Experience the complete CloudCrane website-building workflow.
marketing.pricingStarterDescription: For launching and maintaining one live website.
marketing.pricingStarterFeature8: 2 GB website storage · auto sleep / wake
marketing.pricingProDescription: For multiple websites and ongoing delivery projects.
marketing.pricingProFeature3: Custom domain and backup for every site
marketing.footerDescription: AI website coding agent for building and maintaining real websites.
marketing.footerSubscribeDescription: Get the latest product updates and building tips.
marketing.footerSubscribeSuccess: Thanks for subscribing. We’ll keep you posted.
